# SHAMS Holding brand

<!-- Generated by the SHAMS brand kit (npm run sync). Edit the kit, not this file. -->

**Der rote Faden** (the red thread). SHAMS, cut by one rising line. The cut is empty space; red shows only on the faces it exposes, as if the letters glowed inside. Red belongs to the thread: one red line per view, never decoration.

| Colour | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Red | `#FF1A1A` | The thread on dark, with glow. Nothing else is red. |
| Red print | `#CB0009` | The thread on light and in print: the same hue, darker. |
| Night | `#07070A` | Primary background (dark is the main theme). |
| Night raised | `#0D0D11` | Raised surfaces on dark. |
| Ink | `#F3EFE9` | Headlines and text on dark. |
| Ink soft | `#CFC9C1` | Body copy on dark. |
| Muted | `#8D8881` | Secondary text on dark. |
| Faint | `#4A4741` | Hairlines and tertiary text on dark. |
| Tangle | `#6E6A64` | Background threads on the website. |
| Yarn | `#C9C2B8` | The ball on dark. |
| Core glow | `#FF965F` | The warm light inside the ball, on dark only; always faint. |
| Paper | `#FAF8F5` | Light background. |
| Ink on paper | `#141414` | Text on light and in print. |
| Muted on paper | `#6B6762` | Secondary text on light. |
| Yarn on paper | `#4F4A44` | The ball on light. |

**Type:** Instrument Serif (headlines), Inter (text, wordmark, documents). Both under the SIL Open Font License.

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `web/shams-banner-transparent.png` | Profile banner, dark mode |
| `web/shams-banner-transparent-onlight.png` | Profile banner, light mode |
| `shams-avatar.png` | Organisation avatar, 1024 × 1024 |

Logos in every size and format, icons, letterhead, business cards, email signature and the brand guide are in the brand kit, which generates these files too.
